## Mouse
### Download dataset
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
#Mouse-------
#Download datasets

#GSE120661 ----

#Metadata 
filename = "GSE120661"
GSE120661 <- getGEO("GSE120661", GSEMatrix = TRUE) 
eset <- GSE120661[[1]]

GSE120661_metadata = eset %>% 
  pData() %>% 
  dplyr::select( 
    geo_sample = "geo_accession", 
    subject_id = "title",
    sex = "gender:ch1", 
    treatment = "treatment:ch1", 
    tissue = "tissue:ch1",
    timepoint = "timepoint:ch1",
    animal_replicate = "animal replicate:ch1",
    strain = "strain/background:ch1") %>% 
  mutate(treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "saline"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, "0"),
         condition = paste(treatment, timepoint, tissue, sep = "_"))

#Save
write_csv(GSE120661_metadata, file = here("tables", "influenza_hepatitisb_GSE120661_metadata.csv"))

#Counts matrix from Expression set
eset <- exprs(eset)

eset %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_hepatitisb_GSE120661_exprs.rds"))

```

Import
```{r}
#Import
GSE120661_metadata = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_metadata.rds"))
GSE120661_exprs = read_rds(here("tables", "influenza_hepatitisb_GSE120661_exprs.rds"))

#Check length
GSE120661_exprs %>% rownames() %>% length()

mouse_fluad_metadata = GSE120661_metadata %>% 
  filter(treatment == "Fluad",
         tissue == "PBMC") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint) %>% as.numeric(),
         timepoint = (timepoint / 24) %>% round(1),
         participant_id = paste0("TriFLU-MF59_BL", animal_replicate)) %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c(0, 1, 3, 7))

#Save
mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_metadata.rds"))

#Select only PBMC samples counts
GSE120661_exprs = GSE120661_exprs %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(c(mouse_fluad_metadata$geo_sample)) %>% 
  as.matrix()

GSE120661_exprs %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_exprs.rds"))
```

### Annotate genes
```{r}
## Set up biomart
ensembl_mart <- useMart("ensembl")
ensembl_mart <- useDataset("mmusculus_gene_ensembl", mart = ensembl_mart)

## Get the MGI symbol
gene_id <- GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 %>% rownames()

#Get other annotations
listAttributes(ensembl_mart)

#Annotate
annot <- getBM(
  attributes = c("agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k", #Agilent microarray data (design ID 028005, retrieved from GEO)
                 "ensembl_gene_id",
                 "entrezgene_id",
                 "mgi_symbol",
                 "description"),
  filters = "agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k",
  values = gene_id,
  mart = ensembl_mart)

#Get lookup table from FIT
#Install model package
# library(devtools)
# devtools::install_github('shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man')
library(FIT.mouse2man)
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = mouse_ortholog)

#Get annotations for each probe 
### Filter probes with highest median expression
mouse_fluad_log2summary = GSE120661_exprs %>% #20,845 probes
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot %>% 
              rename(probe = agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k), 
            by = "probe") %>%  #24.009 rows
  #Filter ensembl id
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  
  #Filter entrez id
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%  #21.863 probes/entrez_ids
  ungroup() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = entrezgene_id) %>% 
  
  #Filter hgnc symbol
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez, by = c("mouse_entrez", "mgi_symbol")) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1)  %>% #14.396
  ungroup()

#Filter out genes with multiple mgi_symbols
hgnc_symbol_dupes = mouse_fluad_log2summary %>% 
  #filter ensembl id with multiple mgi_symbols
  get_dupes(hgnc_symbol)

mouse_fluad_log2summary = mouse_fluad_log2summary %>% 
  filter(!hgnc_symbol %in% c(hgnc_symbol_dupes$hgnc_symbol %>% unique())) 

#Modify expression matrix

#Filtered probes
mouse_fluad_log2_filtered_probes = GSE120661_exprs %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_log2summary, by = "probe") %>%   #214,396
  select(human_symbol = hgnc_symbol,
         human_entrez,
         mouse_entrez,
         c(mouse_fluad_metadata$geo_sample))
#14395
mouse_fluad_log2_filtered_probes %>% dim()

mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = mouse_fluad_log2_filtered_probes 

mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% get_dupes(human_symbol)

#Save 
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
```

Create expression set
```{r}
#Import
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
mouse_fluad_metadata = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_metadata.rds")) 


#Annotate
mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%
  # rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol,  timepoint, value = log2) %>%
    distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("day_"),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               names_prefix = "day_",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, human_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(day0 = value[timepoint == "0"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2fc = value - day0) %>%
  filter(timepoint != "0")

#Save
mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))


#Pivot wider
mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_wide = mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  select(-c(value:day0)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id",
              values_from = "log2fc")

beep()

```


### Differential gene expression
```{r}
#Create ExpressionSet --------------
#Import
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
mouse_fluad_metadata = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_metadata.rds")) 


GSE120661_exprs_matrix_fluad = mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(human_symbol, c(mouse_fluad_metadata$geo_sample)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("human_symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix()

#Normalize quantiles
GSE120661_exprs_matrix_fluad_normalized <- normalizeBetweenArrays(GSE120661_exprs_matrix_fluad, 
                                                                   method = "quantile")

#Diagnostics
dim(GSE120661_exprs_matrix_fluad_normalized) #14357   20

dim(AnnotatedDataFrame(mouse_fluad_metadata %>% column_to_rownames("geo_sample"))) #35

#Create new Expression set with the filtered data
eset_filtered <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData = GSE120661_exprs_matrix_fluad_normalized,
  phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame(mouse_fluad_metadata %>%
                                   mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint) %>% as.factor()) %>% 
                                   column_to_rownames("geo_sample")))
```



#### Limma

```{r}
#Create design matrix -------
eset_mouse_fluad = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_eset.rds"))

# Keeping only genes with intensity > 6 (log2) in at least 5 samples
genes_to_keep <- exprs(eset_mouse_fluad) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ . > 6)) %>% 
  rowSums() %>% 
  { . >= 5 }

eset_filtered <- eset_mouse_fluad[genes_to_keep, ]

design <- model.matrix(~ timepoint + 0, eset_filtered) # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Estimate correlation between doses on the same individual
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_filtered, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_filtered$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #0.024


aw <- arrayWeights(eset_filtered, design)
barplot(aw, 
        names.arg = eset_filtered$condition, # Define os nomes no eixo X
        main = "Sample Weights Diagnostic", 
        ylab = "Weight", 
        las = 2,           # Rotaciona os nomes em 90 graus
        cex.names = 0.7,   # Diminui o tamanho da fonte se houver muitos nomes
        col = "skyblue")

#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_filtered, 
             design, 
             weights = aw,
             block = eset_filtered$participant_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus
             ) 

#Contrasts
#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(timepoint1  - timepoint0 ,
                             timepoint3  - timepoint0 ,
                             timepoint7  - timepoint0 ,
                             levels=design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)

# eBayes
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2, trend = T, robust = T)


plotSA(fit2, main = "Sigma vs Abundance (Weights Applied)")

#Get DEGs ------
## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
    
})

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs
all_degs_mouse = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "Time1"	~ "Fluad_1_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "Time3"	~ "Fluad_3_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "Time7"	~ "Fluad_7_PBMC",
                               T~comparisonA),
         timepoint = str_remove(comparisonA, "Time"),
         organism = "Mouse") %>% 
  select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  select(condition, symbol, mean = log_fc, lower = ci_l, upper = ci_r, ave_expr,
         everything())

all_degs_mouse %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_degs = n())
	
#Save
all_degs_mouse %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))
```




#### Simple t-Test
```{r}
#Import
mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = 
  readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))
#Import
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds")) %>% 
  distinct()

mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%
  # rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") 

# Paired t-test
mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest <- mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(timepoint == "day1"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day3"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day7"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~timepoint),
         timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

#Unpaired
mouse_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest <- mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(timepoint == "day1"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day3"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day7"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~timepoint),
         timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired")

mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(mouse_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest) 

mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```


## Human

### Download dataset
Data was quantile normalized signal intensity using limma 3.38.3, read.maimages source = agilent.median, backgroundCorrect method= normexp, normalizeBetweenArrays method= quantile. Ref: GEO.

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
### Download dataset --------
# Data was quantile normalized signal intensity using limma 3.38.3, read.maimages source = agilent.median, backgroundCorrect method= normexp, normalizeBetweenArrays method= quantile. Ref: GEO

###### GSE124689 ----
#Download dataset
GSE124689 <- getGEO("GSE124689", GSEMatrix = TRUE) 
#Get ExpressionSet
eset <- GSE124689[[1]]
#Expression
GSE124689_exprs <- eset %>% exprs()
#Metadata
GSE124689_metadata = eset %>% pData()
#Save
GSE124689_exprs %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_human_GSE124689_exprs.rds"))
```

Import data
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
#Import data
GSE124689_exprs = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_human_GSE124689_exprs.rds"))

#Get metadata annotated by Amnah
# cleandata_nonorm_flu <- readRDS(here("HumanFluData", "cleandata_nonorm_flu.rds")) 
flu_expFC <- readRDS(here("tables", "Flu_Human_expFC.rds"))
# flu_expression_fc = flu_expFC[["exp_fc"]] %>% as.data.frame()
flu_metadata = flu_expFC$cur_phenoData
flu_metadata %>% filter(exposure_material_reported == "FLUADD")

#Filter samples by vaccine
human_samples_pbmc_fluad = flu_metadata %>% 
  filter(exposure_material_reported == "FLUADD")
```

### Annotate features
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
# Annotate genes
probes_annotation <- read.delim(here("tables", "GPL21272-58809.txt"), skip = 19, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "") %>% 
  select(gene_id = ID, entrez_id = ENTREZ_GENE_ID, ensembl_id = ENSEMBL_ID, gene_symbol = GENE_SYMBOL) %>% 
  mutate(gene_id = as.character(gene_id))

GSE124689_counts <- GSE124689_exprs %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>% 
  inner_join(probes_annotation, by = "gene_id") %>% 
  select(gene_id, entrez_id, ensembl_id, gene_symbol, c(human_samples_pbmc_fluad$biosample_accession)) %>% 
  mutate(entrez_id = as.character(entrez_id)) 

#Get probes and entrez IDs with the highest median by ensembl_id
GSE124689_counts_genes_selected = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene_id, entrez_id, ensembl_id, gene_symbol),
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(entrez_id, gene_id) %>% 
  drop_na(entrez_id) %>% 
  summarise(median = median(expression),
            median = round(median, 10)) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Merge
GSE124689_counts_raw = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  inner_join(GSE124689_counts_genes_selected %>% 
               select(gene_id, entrez_id),
             by = join_by("gene_id", "entrez_id"))

#Delete duplicates by sampling
dupes_entrez = GSE124689_counts_genes_selected %>% 
  get_dupes(entrez_id) %>% 
  group_by(entrez_id) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 1)

#Merge
human_fluadd_not_normalized = GSE124689_counts_raw %>%
  select(-gene_symbol) %>% 
  filter(!gene_id %in% c(dupes_entrez$gene_id)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(c(entrez_id, human_samples_pbmc_fluad$uid)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("entrez_id") 

#Save
human_fluadd_not_normalized %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_GSE124689_exprs.rds"))

#Get symbols only
GSE124689_counts_genes_selected_symbol = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene_id, entrez_id, ensembl_id, gene_symbol),
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(gene_symbol, gene_id) %>% 
  filter(gene_symbol != "") %>% 
  drop_na(gene_symbol) %>% 
  summarise(median = median(expression),
            median = round(median, 10)) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

GSE124689_counts_raw_symbol = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  inner_join(GSE124689_counts_genes_selected_symbol %>% 
               select(gene_id, gene_symbol),
             by = join_by("gene_id", "gene_symbol"))

dupes_symbols = GSE124689_counts_genes_selected_symbol %>% 
  get_dupes(gene_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 1)

human_fluadd_not_normalized_symbol = GSE124689_counts_raw_symbol %>%
  filter(!gene_symbol %in% c(dupes_symbols$gene_symbol)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(c(gene_symbol, human_samples_pbmc_fluad$uid)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene_symbol")

human_fluadd_symbol_entrez = GSE124689_counts_raw_symbol %>%
  filter(!gene_symbol %in% c(dupes_symbols$gene_symbol)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(symbol = gene_symbol, entrez_id)

#Save
human_fluadd_not_normalized_symbol %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_GSE124689_exprs_not_normalized.rds"))


human_fluadd_not_normalized_symbol %>% 
  rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(columns_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2fc")

human_fluadd_not_normalized_symbol
```


```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
#Counts matrix from Expression set
flu_metadata_clean = flu_metadata %>% 
  arrange(uid) %>% 
  separate(participant_id, into = c("del", "participant_id")) %>% 
  select(-del) %>% 
  select(sample_id = uid, participant_id, timepoint = study_time_collected, age = age_imputed, sex = gender, race, vaccine = exposure_material_reported, sample_type = cell_type, array = featureSetName2, type = vaccine_type, adjuvant) %>% 
  mutate(age = as.numeric(age),
         sex = as.factor(sex), 
         race = as.factor(race),
         condition = paste(vaccine, "Day", timepoint)) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% c(GSE124689_counts %>% colnames())) %>% 
  arrange(sample_id) %>%
```

```{r All samples}
##### Run analysis in the cluster -------
eset_human = readRDS(file = here("tables", "fluad_eset_human.rds"))

# Keeping only genes with intensity > 6 (log2) in at least 5 samples

#Avoid blank spaces

#Get intra-individual correlation

                               design = design,

corfit$consensus #0.11

aw <- arrayWeights(eset_filtered, design)
barplot(aw, 
        names.arg = eset_filtered$condition, # Define os nomes no eixo X
        main = "Sample Weights Diagnostic",

# Fit Limma model
```

```{r Subsampling example}
library(tidyverse)
library(limma)
library(here)
library(janitor)

# ---- 1. Load Filtered Input Data ----
eset_human <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "fluad_eset_human.rds"))

# Baseline expression filtering threshold from your original script
genes_to_keep <- exprs(eset_human) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ . > 6)) %>% 
  rowSums() %>% 
  { . >= 5 }

eset_filtered <- eset_human[genes_to_keep, ]
meta_df <- as_tibble(pData(eset_filtered), rownames = "sample_id")
expr_matrix <- exprs(eset_filtered)
unique_participants <- meta_df %>% dplyr::pull(participant_id) %>% unique()

# ---- 2. Defensive Subsampling Function Supporting Missing Data ----
draw_flexible_subset <- function(participants_list, metadata, target_n = 5) {
  valid_draw <- FALSE
  attempts <- 0
  
  while(!valid_draw) {
    attempts <- attempts + 1
    if(attempts > 500) stop("Could not find a balanced subset. Please check metadata variance.")
    
    # Randomly sample 5 individuals (irrespective of whether they have missing timepoints)
    selected_ids <- sample(participants_list, size = target_n, replace = FALSE)
    
    # Extract corresponding longitudinal metadata row vectors
    sub_meta <- metadata %>% 
      filter(participant_id %in% selected_ids) %>%
      mutate(condition = as.factor(condition),
             sex = as.factor(sex),
             race = as.factor(race))
    
    # Rule 1 Check: Ensure ALL 4 experimental timepoints are present across the drawn cohort
    # (Prevents contrast failures if no selected individual contains a Day 7 sample)
    has_all_timepoints <- (length(unique(sub_meta$condition)) == 4)
    
    # Rule 2 Check: Ensure demographic covariates are non-uniform (variance > 0)
    diverse_sex  <- (length(unique(sub_meta$sex)) > 1)
    diverse_race <- (length(unique(sub_meta$race)) > 1)
    
    if(has_all_timepoints && diverse_sex && diverse_race) {
      valid_draw = TRUE
    }
  }
  return(sub_meta)
}

# ---- 3. Execute the Controlled Test Iteration ----
set.seed(42) # Locked seed for exact workflow reproducibility

# The resulting sub_meta will safely contain between 17 to 20 samples depending on missing data
sub_meta <- draw_flexible_subset(unique_participants, meta_df, target_n = 5)
sub_expr <- expr_matrix[, sub_meta$sample_id]

# ---- 4. Sanity Check Dimensions (Diagnostic Prints) ----
cat("=== FLEXIBLE DOWNSAMPLING SANITY DIAGNOSTIC ===\n")
cat("Number of unique individuals drawn:", length(unique(sub_meta$participant_id)), "\n")
cat("Total combined samples (Including missing data entries):", nrow(sub_meta), "\n")
cat("Sub-expression matrix dimensions (Genes x Samples):", dim(sub_expr)[1], "x", dim(sub_expr)[2], "\n\n")

# ---- 5. Resilient Linear Modeling via Limma ----

# Recompute design matrix (limma dynamically handles missing rows per factor levels)
design_sub <- model.matrix(~ condition + sex + age + race + 0, data = sub_meta)
colnames(design_sub) <- make.names(colnames(design_sub))

# duplicateCorrelation natively scales across unequal individual block sizes!
corfit_sub <- duplicateCorrelation(sub_expr, design = design_sub, block = sub_meta$participant_id)

cat("Consensus intra-individual correlation for this specific round:", corfit_sub$consensus, "\n")

# Compute empirical sample precision weights
aw_sub <- arrayWeights(sub_expr, design_sub)

# Fit Linear Mixed Model applying sample weights and individual block structures
fit_sub <- lmFit(sub_expr, 
                 design = design_sub, 
                 weights = aw_sub,
                 block = sub_meta$participant_id, 
                 correlation = corfit_sub$consensus)

# Apply your standardized comparison contrast matrix
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionFLUADD.Day.1 - conditionFLUADD.Day.0,
                             conditionFLUADD.Day.3 - conditionFLUADD.Day.0,
                             conditionFLUADD.Day.7 - conditionFLUADD.Day.0,
                             levels = design_sub)

fit2_sub <- contrasts.fit(fit_sub, cont.matrix)
fit2_sub <- eBayes(fit2_sub, robust = TRUE, trend = TRUE)

# ---- 6. Extract and Format Resulting Output ----
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2_sub), function(i) {
  # Extract raw data-frame directly without upfront tibble parsing
  df_res <- topTreat(fit2_sub, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE)
  
  # Inject identification tracking attributes cleanly
  df_res$symbol <- rownames(df_res)
  df_res$comparison <- colnames(fit2_sub)[i]
  
  # Remove row names to keep structural compilation stable
  rownames(df_res) <- NULL
  return(df_res)
})

single_iteration_output <- do.call(rbind, results_list) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  clean_names()

print(head(single_iteration_output))
```


```{r Subsampling loop}
library(tidyverse)
library(limma)
library(here)
library(janitor)

# ---- 1. Load and Pre-Filter ExpressionSet Data ----
eset_human <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "fluad_eset_human.rds"))

# Baseline expression intensity filtering threshold from your script
genes_to_keep <- exprs(eset_human) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ . > 6)) %>% 
  rowSums() %>% 
  { . >= 5 }

eset_filtered <- eset_human[genes_to_keep, ]
meta_df <- as_tibble(pData(eset_filtered), rownames = "sample_id")
expr_matrix <- exprs(eset_filtered)
unique_participants <- meta_df %>% pull(participant_id) %>% unique()

# ---- 2. Defensive Longitudinal Subsampling Function ----
draw_flexible_subset <- function(participants_list, metadata, target_n = 5) {
  valid_draw <- FALSE
  attempts <- 0
  
  while(!valid_draw) {
    attempts <- attempts + 1
    if(attempts > 2000) stop("Could not find a mathematically stable sub-cohort. Check metadata variance.")
    
    # Randomly sample N individuals (keeping longitudinal profiles grouped)
    selected_ids <- sample(participants_list, size = target_n, replace = FALSE)
    
    sub_meta <- metadata %>% 
      filter(participant_id %in% selected_ids) %>%
      mutate(condition = as.factor(condition))
    
    # Rule Check: Ensure ALL 4 sequential vaccine timepoints are present in the draw
    has_all_timepoints <- (length(unique(sub_meta$condition)) == 4)
    
    if(has_all_timepoints) {
      # Build lean design matrix using only condition and the age continuous vector
      test_design <- model.matrix(~ condition + age + 0, data = sub_meta)
      colnames(test_design) <- make.names(colnames(test_design))
      
      # Validate full-rank math via limma's official public function
      bad_coefs <- limma::nonEstimable(test_design)
      
      if(is.null(bad_coefs)) {
        valid_draw <- TRUE
      }
    }
  }
  return(sub_meta)
}

# ---- 3. Run Multi-Iteration Simulation Loop ----
n_iterations <- 20 
mouse_n <- 5       

set.seed(123) # Lock global seed for absolute drawing reproducibility

df_global_runs <- tibble(iteration = 1:n_iterations) %>%
  mutate(
    # Step A: Perform structural full-rank longitudinal sampling
    sampled_metadata = map(iteration, ~ draw_flexible_subset(unique_participants, meta_df, target_n = mouse_n)),
    
    # Step B: Run optimized memory-safe Limma modeling matrix rows
    limma_results = map(sampled_metadata, ~ {
      sub_meta <- .x
      sub_expr <- expr_matrix[, sub_meta$sample_id]
      
      # Lean design matrix formula
      design_sub <- model.matrix(~ condition + 
                                   # age +
                                   # sex +
                                   # race +
                                   0, data = sub_meta)
      colnames(design_sub) <- make.names(colnames(design_sub))
      
      # Compute iteration-specific correlation structures and sample weights
      corfit_sub <- duplicateCorrelation(sub_expr, design = design_sub, block = sub_meta$participant_id)
      aw_sub <- arrayWeights(sub_expr, design_sub)
      
      # Fit linear mixed model
      fit_sub <- lmFit(sub_expr, 
                       design = design_sub, 
                       weights = aw_sub,
                       block = sub_meta$participant_id, 
                       correlation = corfit_sub$consensus)
      
      # Reapply your original contrast comparisons vector
      cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionFLUADD.Day.1 - conditionFLUADD.Day.0,
                                   conditionFLUADD.Day.3 - conditionFLUADD.Day.0,
                                   conditionFLUADD.Day.7 - conditionFLUADD.Day.0,
                                   levels = design_sub)
      
      fit2_sub <- contrasts.fit(fit_sub, cont.matrix)
      fit2_sub <- eBayes(fit2_sub, robust = TRUE, trend = TRUE)
      
      # Streamlined raw matrix mapping without dynamic tibble overhead
      res_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2_sub), function(i) {
        df_res <- topTreat(fit2_sub, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE)
        df_res$symbol <- rownames(df_res)
        df_res$comparison <- colnames(fit2_sub)[i]
        rownames(df_res) <- NULL
        return(df_res)
      })
      
      do.call(rbind, res_list)
    })
  )

# ---- 4. Data Processing & Summary via Protective Medians ----
fluad_human_subsampled_degs <- df_global_runs %>%
  select(iteration, limma_results) %>%
  unnest(limma_results) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  group_by(comparison, symbol) %>%
  summarise(
    # Pull defensive median vectors to filter individual background variations
    p_value = median(p_value),
    adj_p_val = median(adj_p_val),
    mean = median(log_fc),
    lower = median(ci_l),
    upper = median(ci_r),
    ave_expr = median(ave_expr),
    # Reviewer Defense Metric: Empirical probability of a gene converging as active
    pct_iterations_significant = mean(adj_p_val <= 0.05) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Apply your original character transformations to normalize text outputs
  mutate(comparison = stringr::str_replace_all(comparison, "\\.", " "),
         comparison = stringr::str_replace_all(comparison, "condition", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  select(condition = comparisonA, everything(), -comparisonRef) %>% 
  # Join fixed baseline target mapping categories from original metadata frame
  inner_join(meta_df %>% 
               select(condition, timepoint, vaccine, sample_type) %>% 
               distinct(), by = "condition") %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human") %>%
  select(condition, symbol, mean, lower, upper, ave_expr, p_val = p_value, adj_p_val, 
         pct_iterations_significant, timepoint, vaccine, sample_type, organism)

# ---- 5. Save Aggregated Output Matrix File ----
fluad_human_subsampled_degs %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_dge_subsampled_degs.rds"))

# ---- 6. Print Summary Metric Reports ----
fluad_human_subsampled_degs %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_robust_degs = n()) %>% 
  print()

```

```{r}
human_mouse_fluad_matrix = eset_human_mouse %>% exprs()
human_mouse_fluad_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_metadata.rds.png"))


human_mouse_fluad_matrix_human = human_mouse_fluad_matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(c(human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
           filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
             filter(!participant_id %in% c("CRC305DGENT1483036",
                                             "CRC305DGENT0351013",
                                             "CRC305DGENT1471032")) %>% 
             pull(sample_id))) %>%

human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData = human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>%

                                   filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
                                   filter(!participant_id %in% c("CRC305DGENT1483036",

  mutate(timepoint = as.factor(timepoint),

         age = scale(as.numeric(age)),
         race = as.factor(race))

#Annotate
human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = human_mouse_fluad_matrix_human %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData %>% 
               rownames_to_column("geo_sample") %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("day_"),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               names_prefix = "day_",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, human_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(day0 = value[timepoint == "0"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2fc = value - day0) %>%
  filter(timepoint != "0") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData %>% 
               rownames_to_column("geo_sample") %>% 
               select(participant_id, timepoint, geo_sample),
             by = join_by("participant_id", "timepoint"))

#Save
human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_log2fc_sample_long.rds"))


#Pivot wider
human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_wide = human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  select(-c(value:day0)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id",
              values_from = "log2fc")

beep()
```

```{r}
#Import
human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = 
  readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_log2fc_sample_long.rds"))


#Compute summary statistics
human_fluad_log2fc_summary = human_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

human_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = human_mouse_fluad_matrix_human %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_pData %>% 
               rownames_to_column("geo_sample") %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_")

# Paired t-test
human_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest <- human_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(timepoint == "day1"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day3"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day7"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~timepoint),
         timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

# Unpaired t-test ----------
human_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest <- human_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(
      t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(
      t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(
      t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      timepoint == "day1" ~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
      timepoint == "day3" ~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
      timepoint == "day7" ~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
      TRUE ~ timepoint),
    timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
    test = "t-Test",
    paired = "Unpaired")




human_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = human_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(human_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest) 

human_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_dge_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))
```

#### Differential expression 

##### Limma
Paired samples design
```{r}

#Import
mouse_engerixb_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_exprs.rds"))
mouse_engerixb_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_metadata.rds"))
eset_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_eset.rds"))

# Keeping only genes with intensity > 6 (log2) in at least 5 samples
genes_to_keep <- exprs(eset_mouse) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ . > 6)) %>% 
  rowSums() %>% 
  { . >= 5 }

eset_filtered <- eset_mouse[genes_to_keep, ]

#Create model matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ condition + 0, # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
                       eset_filtered) 
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Estimate the correlation between measurements made on the same subject (paired-samples)
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_filtered, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_filtered$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #-0.02688727


aw <- arrayWeights(eset_filtered, design)
barplot(aw, 
        names.arg = eset_filtered$condition, # Define os nomes no eixo X
        main = "Sample Weights Diagnostic", 
        ylab = "Weight", 
        las = 2,           # Rotaciona os nomes em 90 graus
        cex.names = 0.7,   # Diminui o tamanho da fonte se houver muitos nomes
        col = "skyblue")


#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_filtered, 
             design, 
             weights = aw,
             block = eset_filtered$participant_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus) #Use inter-subject correlation as input into the linear model fit

#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

#Get contrasts 
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionEngerix.B_24_PBMC	 - conditionEngerix.B_0_PBMC,
                             conditionEngerix.B_72_PBMC	 - conditionEngerix.B_0_PBMC,
                             conditionEngerix.B_168_PBMC	 - conditionEngerix.B_0_PBMC,
                             levels=design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2, 
               robust = T, 
               trend = T)

plotSA(fit2, main = "Sigma vs Abundance (Weights Applied)")
#Get DEGs

## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs and clean dataset
all_degs_mouse_engerixb = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "conditionEngerix.B_24_PBMC"	~ "Engerix_24_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionEngerix.B_72_PBMC"	~ "Engerix_72_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionEngerix.B_168_PBMC"	~ "Engerix_168_PBMC",
                               T~comparisonA),
         organism = "Mouse") %>% 
  select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)
	
# #Save
all_degs_mouse_engerixb %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

all_degs_mouse_engerixb %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_degs = n())

```

```{r}
#EngerixB: GSE124533 -----
filename = "GSE124533"
```

```{r}
########### Filter and annotate probes -----
probes_annotation <- read.delim(here("tables", "GPL21272-58809.txt"), skip = 19, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "") %>% 
  select(gene_id = ID, entrez_id = ENTREZ_GENE_ID, ensembl_id = ENSEMBL_ID, gene_symbol = GENE_SYMBOL) %>% 
  mutate(gene_id = as.character(gene_id))


#Get annotations for each probe 
### Filter probes with highest median expression
human_engerix_log2summary = human_exprs_engerixb %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(probes_annotation %>% 
              rename(probe = gene_id,
                     entrezgene_id = entrez_id,
                     human_symbol = gene_symbol), 
            by = "probe") %>% 
  #Filter ensembl id
  group_by(ensembl_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ensembl_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  
  #Filter entrez id
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%  #21.863 probes/entrez_ids
  ungroup() 

#Filter out genes with multiple hgnc_symbols
hgnc_symbol_dupes = human_engerix_log2summary %>% 
  #filter ensembl id with multiple hgnc_symbols
  get_dupes(human_symbol)

human_engerix_log2summary = human_engerix_log2summary %>% 
  filter(!human_symbol %in% c(hgnc_symbol_dupes$human_symbol %>% unique())) 

#Modify expression matrix

  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  inner_join(human_engerix_log2summary, by = "probe") %>%   #214,396
  select(human_symbol,
         c(human_engerixb_metadata$geo_sample))

human_engerix_log2_filtered_probes %>% dim()

human_engerix_log2_hgnc_symbol = human_engerix_log2_filtered_probes 

human_engerix_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%

human_engerix_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%
```

### Differential expression


##### Limma

```{r}
#Import
human_engerix_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
human_metadata_filtered = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_metadata.rds"))
eset_human = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_eset.rds"))

# Keeping only genes with intensity > 6 (log2) in at least 5 samples
genes_to_keep <- exprs(eset_human) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ . > 6)) %>% 
  rowSums() %>% 
  { . >= 5 }

eset_filtered <- eset_human[genes_to_keep, ]

#Create design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ timepoint + sex + age + race + 0, eset_filtered) 

#Avoid blank spaces
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

#Get intra-individual correlation
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_filtered, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_filtered$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #0.30

aw <- arrayWeights(eset_filtered, design)
barplot(aw, 
        names.arg = eset_filtered$condition,
        main = "Sample Weights Diagnostic", 
        ylab = "Weight", 
        las = 2,           
        cex.names = 0.7,   
        col = "skyblue")


# Fit
engerix_human_limma_fit <- lmFit(eset_filtered, 
                                 design, 
                                 weights = aw,
                                 block = eset_filtered$participant_id, 
                                 correlation = corfit$consensus)

# Contrasts
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(
  timepoint1 - timepoint0,
  timepoint3 - timepoint0,
  timepoint7 - timepoint0,
  levels = design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(engerix_human_limma_fit, cont.matrix)

# eBayes
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2, 
               robust = T, 
               trend = T)

plotSA(fit2, main = "Sigma vs Abundance (Weights Applied)")

fit2 %>% saveRDS(here("tables","hepatitisb_engerixb_human_limma_fit.rds"))

#Import results from Cluster 
fit2 = readRDS(here("tables","hepatitisb_engerixb_human_limma_fit.rds"))

# Extract
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTable(fit2, coef = i, adjust.method = "fdr", number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
})


# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs
all_degs_human = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  #Clean table
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "Time1"	~ "EngerixB_Day1",
                               comparisonA == "Time3"	~ "EngerixB_Day3",
                               comparisonA == "Time7"	~ "EngerixB_Day7",
                               T~comparisonA),
         organism = "Human") %>% 
  select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)

all_degs_human %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_degs = n())
	
#Save
all_degs_human %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_dge_limma_degs.rds"))
```


##### Simple t-Test
```{r}
#Import
human_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = 
  readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))
#Import
human_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds")) %>% 
  distinct()

human_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_metadata.rds"))

#Compute summary statistics
human_log2fc_summary = human_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

human_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = human_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(human_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_")

# Paired t-test
human_log2fc_paired_ttest <- human_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

#Unpaired
human_log2fc_unpaired_ttest <- human_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired")

human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = human_log2fc_paired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(human_log2fc_unpaired_ttest) 

human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

### Compare DGE methods
```{r}
#Import ------
#t-Test
human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")
mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse")

#Limma
human_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired",
         timepoint = str_remove(comparison_a, "Time"))

mouse_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired",
         timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Engerix_") %>% str_remove("_PBMC"),
         timepoint = (as.numeric(timepoint)/24) %>% as.character())

#Merge datasets
degs_ttest_limma =
  bind_rows(
    human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    human_degs,
    mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    mouse_degs
    )

#Summarize  
degs_ttest_limma_summary = degs_ttest_limma %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, test, paired) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_degs = sum(padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 

degs_ttest_limma_summary
```

```{r}
########### Filter and annotate probes -----
## Set up biomart
ensembl_mart <- useMart("ensembl")
ensembl_mart <- useDataset("mmusculus_gene_ensembl", mart = ensembl_mart)

## Get the MGI symbol
gene_id <- mouse_exprs %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe_id") %>% 
  pull(probe_id) %>% unique()

# listAttributes(ensembl_mart)
#Annotate
annot <- getBM(
  attributes = c("affy_mouse430_2",
                 "ensembl_gene_id",
                 "entrezgene_id",
                 "mgi_symbol",
                 "description"),
  filters = "affy_mouse430_2", #Probes
  values = gene_id,
  mart = ensembl_mart)

annot %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "probe_annot_saureus_infection_mouse.rds"))

#Get lookup table from FIT
#Install model package
# library(devtools)
# devtools::install_github('shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man')
library(FIT.mouse2man)
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = mouse_ortholog)

#Get annotations for each probe 
### Filter probes with highest median expression
mouse_log2summary = mouse_exprs %>% #20,845 probes
  rownames_to_column("probe_id") %>% 
  rename(probe = probe_id) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot %>% 
              rename(probe = affy_mouse430_2), 
            by = "probe") %>%  #24.009 rows
  #Filter ensembl id
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  
  #Filter entrez id
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%  #21.863 probes/entrez_ids
  ungroup() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = entrezgene_id) %>% 
  
  #Filter hgnc symbol
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez, by = c("mouse_entrez", "mgi_symbol")) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1)  %>% #14.396
  ungroup()

#Filter out genes with multiple mgi_symbols
hgnc_symbol_dupes = mouse_log2summary %>% 
  #filter ensembl id with multiple mgi_symbols
  get_dupes(hgnc_symbol)

#Filter out probes with multiple mgi and hgnc symbols
probe_dupes = mouse_log2summary %>% get_dupes(probe)

mouse_log2summary = mouse_log2summary %>% 
  select(probe, hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  filter(!hgnc_symbol %in% c(hgnc_symbol_dupes$hgnc_symbol %>% unique()),
         !probe %in% c(probe_dupes$probe %>% unique())) 

#Modify expression matrix

#Filtered probes
mouse_log2_filtered_probes = mouse_exprs %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe_id") %>% 
  rename(probe = probe_id) %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_log2summary, by = "probe") %>%   #214,396
  select(human_symbol = hgnc_symbol,
         probe,
         c(mouse_metadata %>% 
             pull(geo_sample)))
#Check
mouse_log2_filtered_probes %>% dim()
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol = mouse_log2_filtered_probes 
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% get_dupes(probe)

#Save
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables","saureus_infection_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
```

### Differential expression 

#### Limma
Paired samples design
```{r}

#Import
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
mouse_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_metadata_filtered.rds"))
eset_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_eset.rds"))

# Keeping only genes with intensity > 6 (log2) in at least 5 samples
genes_to_keep <- exprs(eset_mouse) %>%
as.data.frame() %>%
mutate(across(everything(), ~ . > 6)) %>%
rowSums() %>%
{ . >= 5 }

eset_filtered <- eset_mouse[genes_to_keep, ]
#Create model matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ condition + 0, # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
                       eset_filtered) 

colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Estimate the correlation between measurements made on the same subject (paired-samples)
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_filtered, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_filtered$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #0.001357108


aw <- arrayWeights(eset_filtered, design)
barplot(aw,
names.arg = eset_filtered$condition, 
main = "Sample Weights Diagnostic",
ylab = "Weight",
las = 2,
cex.names = 0.7, 
col = "skyblue")


#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_filtered, 
             design, 
             weights = aw,
             block = eset_filtered$participant_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus) #Use inter-subject correlation as input into the linear model fit

#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

#Get contrasts 
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_2.hours - conditionnone_C57BL.6J_0,
                             conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_4.hours - conditionnone_C57BL.6J_0,
                             conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_6.hours - conditionnone_C57BL.6J_0,
                             conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_12.hours - conditionnone_C57BL.6J_0,
                             levels=design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2,
               robust = T,
               trend = T)

plotSA(fit2, main = "Sigma vs Abundance (Weights Applied)")

#Get DEGs

## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs and clean dataset
all_degs = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "conditionnone_C57BL.6J_0", "0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_2.hours"	~ "Saureus_2h",
                               comparisonA == "conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_4.hours"	~ "Saureus_4h",
                               comparisonA == "conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_6.hours"	~ "Saureus_6h",
                               comparisonA == "conditionStaphylococcus.aureus_C57BL.6J_12.hours"	~ "Saureus_12h",
                               T~comparisonA),
         organism = "Mouse",
         timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Saureus_") %>% str_remove("h")) %>% 
  select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)
	
# #Save
all_degs %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

all_degs %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_degs = n())

```




#### T test 
```{r}
#Import
mouse_exprs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds")) %>% 
  ungroup()
mouse_metadata =  readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_metadata_filtered.rds"))
log2fc_sample = readRDS(here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))
log2fc_sample_symbol = log2fc_sample %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_exprs %>% 
               select(human_symbol, probe_id = probe) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "probe_id")

#Compute summary statistics
log2fc_summary = log2fc_sample_symbol %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = mouse_exprs %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(human_symbol, probe),
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, subject_id = participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, subject_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(subject_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "hour_") 

# Paired t-test
log2fc_paired_ttest <- log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_hour2 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_2, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour4 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_4, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour6 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_6, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour12 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_12, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),

    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_hour2 = p.adjust(pval_hour2, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour4 = p.adjust(pval_hour4, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour6 = p.adjust(pval_hour6, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour12 = p.adjust(pval_hour12, method = "fdr"),
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(hour\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "hour"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

#Unpaired
log2fc_unpaired_ttest = log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_hour2 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_2, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour4 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_4, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour6 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_6, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour12 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_12, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_hour2 = p.adjust(pval_hour2, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour4 = p.adjust(pval_hour4, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour6 = p.adjust(pval_hour6, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour12 = p.adjust(pval_hour12, method = "fdr"),
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(hour\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "hour"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired") 

log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = log2fc_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(log2fc_paired_ttest) 

log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

### Prepare data
```{r}
#S. aureus: GSE33341 -----
filename = "GSE33341"
GSE <- getGEO("GSE33341", GSEMatrix = TRUE) 
eset <- GSE[[2]] #The matrix #1 the mouse annotated

#Metadata ------
GSE_metadata = eset %>% 
  pData() %>% 
  dplyr::select( 
    geo_sample = "geo_accession", 
    participant_id = "title",
    sex = "host gender:ch1",
    condition = "source_name_ch1",
    pathogen = "pathogen:ch1",
    description = "source_name_ch1", 
    ethnicity = "ethnicity:ch1",
    tissue_infection = "anatomic site of infection:ch1",
    batch_experimental = "experimental batch:ch1",
    age = "host age (yr):ch1") %>% 
  mutate(condition = pathogen,
         organism = "Human",
         timepoint = 1,
         time_unit = "Day",
         tissue = "Blood",
         participant_id = str_extract(participant_id, "\\[.*?\\]") %>% 
           str_remove("\\[") %>% 
           str_remove("\\]"),
         condition = case_when(description == "blood patient with E. coli bacteremia prior antibiotic treatment (Emergency Department)" ~ "E. coli prior antibiotic",
                               description == "blood patient with S. aureus bacteremia prior antibiotic treatment (Emergency Department)" ~ "S aureus prior antibiotic",
                               description == "blood human NOT infected" ~ "No infection",
                               T ~ description),
         pathogen = if_else(pathogen == "-", "Healthy", pathogen))
#Save
GSE_metadata %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_metadata.rds"))

#Filter metadata
GSE_metadata_filtered = GSE_metadata %>%
  filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Healthy")) %>% 
  select(geo_sample, participant_id, condition, timepoint, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(ethnicity = str_to_title(ethnicity)) %>% 
  filter(batch_experimental != "2739",
         ethnicity != "Unknown",
         age != "unknown")
```

```{r}
human_exprs_metadata  = human_exprs %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe_id") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe_id,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "value_raw") %>%

#Get value from healthy and calculate Log2FC
```

```{r}
  #Filter ensembl id

  ungroup()
```

### Differential expression

#### Limma

```{r}
#Import
eset_human = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_eset.rds"))

# Keeping only genes with intensity > 6 (log2) in at least 5 samples
genes_to_keep <- exprs(eset_human) %>%
as.data.frame() %>%
mutate(across(everything(), ~ . > 6)) %>%
rowSums() %>%
  { . >= 5 }

eset_filtered <- eset_human[genes_to_keep, ]

#Create model matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ pathogen +
                         age +
                         sex +
                         ethnicity +
                         batch_experimental,
                       data = pData(eset_filtered))

colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  
rownames(design) <- rownames(pData(eset_filtered))


aw <- arrayWeights(eset_filtered, design,
                   var.group = eset_filtered$batch_experimental
                   )
barplot(
  aw,
  names.arg = eset_filtered$condition,
  main = "Sample Weights Diagnostic",
  ylab = "Weight",
  las = 2,
  cex.names = 0.7,
  col = "skyblue"
)

#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_filtered, 
             design,
             weights = aw
             ) 

#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

#Get contrasts 
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(pathogenStaphylococcus.aureus, levels = design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- limma::eBayes(fit2,
                      robust = T,
                      trend = T
                      )

plotSA(fit2, main = "Sigma vs Abundance (Weights Applied)")

#Get DEGs
# For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs and clean dataset
all_degs_human = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  dplyr::select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(condition = case_when(comparison == "pathogenStaphylococcus.aureus"	~ "Saureus_Day1",
                               T~comparison),
         organism = "Human",
         timepoint = "1") %>% 
  dplyr::select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)

all_degs_human %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(n_degs = n())

#Save
all_degs_human %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

```


#### T test 
```{r}
#Import
human_exprs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds")) 
human_metadata =  readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_metadata.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = if_else(condition == "No infection", 0, timepoint))
log2fc_sample = readRDS(here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))
log2fc_sample_symbol = log2fc_sample %>% 
  inner_join(human_exprs %>% 
               select(human_symbol, probe_id = probe) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "probe_id")

#Compute summary statistics
log2fc_summary = log2fc_sample_symbol %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = human_exprs %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(human_symbol, probe),
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(human_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, subject_id = participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, subject_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(subject_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") 


#Unpaired
log2fc_unpaired_ttest = log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1  = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired") 

log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = log2fc_unpaired_ttest 

log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

```{r}
#Import ------
#t-Test
human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human",

#Limma
human_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Unpaired",
         timepoint = "24")

  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired") 

#Merge datasets
degs_ttest_limma =
  bind_rows(
    human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    human_degs,
    mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    mouse_degs
    )

#Summarize  
degs_ttest_limma_summary = degs_ttest_limma %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, test, paired) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_degs = sum(padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 

degs_ttest_limma_summary
```

```{r}
#Get annotations for each probe 
### Filter probes with highest median expression
mouse_log2summary = ecoli_mouse_exprs %>% #20,845 probes
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename(probe = probe_id) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot %>% 
              rename(probe = affy_mouse430_2), 
            by = "probe") %>%  #24.009 rows
  #Filter ensembl id
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  
  #Filter entrez id
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%  #21.863 probes/entrez_ids
  ungroup() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = entrezgene_id) %>% 
  
  #Filter hgnc symbol
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez, by = c("mouse_entrez", "mgi_symbol")) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1)  %>% #14.396
  ungroup()

#Filter out genes with multiple mgi_symbols
hgnc_symbol_dupes = mouse_log2summary %>% 
  #filter ensembl id with multiple mgi_symbols
  get_dupes(hgnc_symbol)

mouse_log2summary = mouse_log2summary %>% 
  select(probe, hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  filter(!hgnc_symbol %in% c(hgnc_symbol_dupes$hgnc_symbol %>% unique())) 

#Modify expression matrix

#Filtered probes
mouse_log2_filtered_probes = ecoli_mouse_exprs %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename(probe = probe_id) %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_log2summary, by = "probe") %>%   #214,396
  select(human_symbol = hgnc_symbol, 
         probe,
         c(mouse_metadata %>% 
             pull(geo_sample)))
#14395
mouse_log2_filtered_probes %>% dim()

mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol = mouse_log2_filtered_probes 

mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
  get_dupes(human_symbol)

#Save
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol_long.rds"))
```

###### Limma
Paired samples design
```{r}

#Import
ecoli_mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol_long.rds"))
ecoli_mouse_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_metadata.rds"))
eset_mouse_ecoli = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_eset.rds"))

# Keeping only genes with intensity > 6 (log2) in at least 5 samples
genes_to_keep <- exprs(eset_mouse_ecoli) %>%
as.data.frame() %>%
mutate(across(everything(), ~ . > 6)) %>%
rowSums() %>%
  { . >= 5 }

eset_filtered <- eset_mouse_ecoli[genes_to_keep, ]

#Create model matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ condition + 0, # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
                       eset_filtered) 

colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Estimate the correlation between measurements made on the same subject (paired-samples)
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_filtered, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_filtered$subject_id)
corfit$consensus #-0.06

aw <- arrayWeights(eset_filtered, design)
barplot(
  aw,
  names.arg = eset_filtered$condition,
  main = "Sample Weights Diagnostic",
  ylab = "Weight",
  las = 2,
  cex.names = 0.7,
  col = "skyblue"
)



#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_filtered, 
             design, 
             weights = aw,
             block = eset_filtered$subject_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus)

#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

#Get contrasts 
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_2	 - conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_0,
                             conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_6	 - conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_0,
                             conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_12	 - conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_0,
                             conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_24	 - conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_0,
                             levels=design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2,
               robust = T,
               trend = T)

plotSA(fit2, main = "Sigma vs Abundance (Weights Applied)")

#Get DEGs

## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs and clean dataset
all_degs_mouse_ecoli= all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_2"	~ "Ecoli_2h",
                               comparisonA == "conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_6"	~ "Ecoli_6h",
                               comparisonA == "conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_12"	~ "Ecoli_12h",
                               comparisonA == "conditionMouse_C57BL.6J_24"	~ "Ecoli_24h",
                               T~comparisonA),
         organism = "Mouse",
         timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Ecoli_") %>% str_remove("h")) %>% 
  select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)
	
# #Save
all_degs_mouse_ecoli %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

all_degs_mouse_ecoli %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_degs = n())

```



###### T test
```{r}
#Import
mouse_exprs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol_long.rds"))
mouse_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_metadata.rds"))
```
