

```{r}
#Compute summary statistics
log2fc_summary = log2fc_sample_symbol %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = mouse_exprs %>%
  select(-probe) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, subject_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, subject_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(subject_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "hour_") 

# Paired t-test
log2fc_paired_ttest <- log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_hour2 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_2, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour6 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_6, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour12 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_12, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour24 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_24, hour_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_hour2 = p.adjust(pval_hour2, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour6 = p.adjust(pval_hour6, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour12 = p.adjust(pval_hour12, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour24 = p.adjust(pval_hour24, method = "fdr"),
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(hour\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "hour"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

#Unpaired
log2fc_unpaired_ttest = log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_hour2 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_2, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour6 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_6, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour12 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_12, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_hour24 = tryCatch(t.test(hour_24, hour_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_hour2 = p.adjust(pval_hour2, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour6 = p.adjust(pval_hour6, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour12 = p.adjust(pval_hour12, method = "fdr"),
    padj_hour24 = p.adjust(pval_hour24, method = "fdr"),
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(hour\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "hour"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired") 

log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = log2fc_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(log2fc_paired_ttest) 

log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

```{r}
  inner_join(human_expression_metadata %>%
```

```{r}
{ . >= 5 }

                       data = pData(eset_filtered))

  dplyr::mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "statusinfected"	~ "Ecoli_24h",
                               T~comparisonA),

        timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Ecoli_") %>% str_remove("h")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(condition, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
```

```{r}
#Import ------
#t-Test
human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_log2fc_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

  mutate(organism = "Mouse")

#Limma
human_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Unpaired") 

mouse_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired") 

#Merge datasets
degs_ttest_limma =
  bind_rows(
    human_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    human_degs,
    mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    mouse_degs
    )

#Summarize  
degs_ttest_limma_summary = degs_ttest_limma %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, test, paired) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_degs = sum(padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 

degs_ttest_limma_summary
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# Plot number of DEGs per test and significance level

  )) +
  
  # Alpha: paired = 1, unpaired = 0.5
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Paired" = 1, "Unpaired" = 0.2)) +

    breaks = sort(unique(degs_ttest_limma_summary$timepoint)),
```

#5. Burn and Trauma 


##Download datasets

### Human

#### Trauma, Human (GSE36809)
Clinical metadata were curated and standardized to ensure consistency across the dataset. The time elapsed since injury, originally recorded in hours, was converted to days and rounded to one decimal place. To account for the irregular temporal distribution of samples, timepoints were discretized into seven categorical bins: <1 day (Early Hours), 1–2 days, 2–5 days, 5–10 days, 10–18 days, 18–25 days, and >25 days. Samples were stratified into 'Trauma' and 'Control' groups based on subject identifiers. Rigorous quality control was applied by excluding samples explicitly flagged in the metadata for low RNA quality or incomplete temporal data. Finally, temporal bins were treated as ordered factors to facilitate downstream differential expression modeling.

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
#Download datasets
filename = "trauma_human"
GSE_matrix <- getGEO(filename = here("tables", "GSE36809_series_matrix.txt.gz"), 
                     GSEMatrix = T)

#Get Expression Set
eset <- GSE_matrix

#Get metadata -------
GSE_metadata = eset %>% Biobase::pData()

#Select, clean, and standardize attributes
GSE_metadata_annotated = GSE_metadata %>% 
  select(geo_sample = "geo_accession",
         sample_id = "source_name_ch1",
         description = title,
         tissue = `tissue:ch1`,
         sex = `Sex:ch1`,
         age = "age:ch1",
         timepoint = `hours_since_injury:ch1`,
         platform_id
         ) %>% 
  separate(sample_id, sep = ", ", into = c("subject_id", "delete")) %>% 
  select(-delete) %>% 
    mutate(timepoint = if_else(timepoint == "N/A", "0", timepoint),
         timepoint = (as.numeric(timepoint)/24) %>% round(x = ., digits = 1),
         subject_id = str_remove(subject_id, "Subject "),
         geo = "GSE36809",
         organism = "Human",
         treatment = if_else(subject_id != "Control", "Trauma", "Control")) %>% 
  filter(!description %in% c("Please notice that this sample with low RNA quality.", 
                            "Sample from patients with incomplete time points.")) %>% 
  mutate(
    
    # Binned timepoints
    timepoints_new = case_when(
      timepoint < 1            ~ "Early_Hours",
      timepoint >= 1 & timepoint < 2  ~ "Day_1",
      timepoint >= 2 & timepoint < 5  ~ "Day_3",
      timepoint >= 5 & timepoint < 10 ~ "Day_7",
      timepoint >= 10 & timepoint < 18 ~ "Day_14",
      timepoint >= 18 & timepoint < 25 ~ "Day_21",
      timepoint >= 25          ~ "Day_28",
      TRUE                         ~ "Other"
    ),
    
    #Explicit bins
    timepoints_bin = case_when(
      timepoint < 1            ~ "<Day_1",
      timepoint >= 1 & timepoint < 2  ~ "Day_1_>=1 to <2",
      timepoint >= 2 & timepoint < 5  ~ "Day_3_>=2 to <5",
      timepoint >= 5 & timepoint < 10 ~ "Day_7_>=5 to <10",
      timepoint >= 10 & timepoint < 18 ~ "Day_14_>=10 to <18",
      timepoint >= 18 & timepoint < 25 ~ "Day_21_>=18 to <25",
      timepoint >= 25          ~ "Day_28_>25",
      TRUE                         ~ "Other"
    ),
    
    timepoints_new = factor(timepoints_new, levels = c("Early_Hours", "Day_1", "Day_3", "Day_7", "Day_14", "Day_21", "Day_28"))
  )



GSE_metadata_annotated %>% 
  group_by(subject_id)%>%
  arrange(subject_id, timepoint) %>%
  View()

GSE_metadata_annotated %>% 
  filter(subject_id != "Control") %>% 
  group_by(subject_id)%>%
  summarise(n_timepoints = n()) %>% 
  arrange(subject_id, n_timepoints) %>% 
  filter(n_timepoints > 1) # -10 participants


GSE_metadata_annotated %>% 
  group_by(timepoints_new, treatment)%>%
  summarise(n_sample = n()) %>% 
  arrange(timepoints_new) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoints_new,
      size = n_sample,
      y = treatment,
      color = treatment) +
  geom_point()

GSE_metadata_annotated_filtered = GSE_metadata_annotated %>% 
  filter(timepoints_new %in% c("Early_Hours", "Day_1", "Day_3", "Day_7"))


#Save metadata
write_csv(GSE_metadata_annotated_filtered, file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_metadata.csv")))

#Get counts matrix ------
GSE_exprs <- eset %>% exprs()

#Save as RDS
GSE_exprs %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(GSE_metadata_annotated_filtered$geo_sample) %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_exprs.rds")))

```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
#Download datasets
filename = "trauma_burn_mouse"
GSE_matrix <- getGEO(filename = here("tables", "GSE7404_series_matrix.txt.gz"), 
                     GSEMatrix = T)

#Get Expression Set
eset <- GSE_matrix

#Get metadata -------
GSE_metadata = eset %>% Biobase::pData()

#Select, clean, and standardize attributes
GSE_metadata_annotated = GSE_metadata %>% 
  select(geo_sample = "geo_accession",
         sample_id = "source_name_ch1",
         participant_description = title,
         characteristics = characteristics_ch1,
         timepoint = `time:ch1`,
         genetic = `genetic background:ch1`,
         tissue = `source_name_ch1`,
         organism = organism_ch1,
         description = description,
         # sex = `Sex:ch1`,
         platform_id
         ) %>% 
  filter(tissue == "mouse leukocytes") %>% 
  fill(genetic, .direction = "up") %>% 
  mutate(treatment = case_when(str_detect(description, "burn") ~ "Burn", 
                               str_detect(description, "trauma") ~ "Trauma", 
                               str_detect(description, "LPS") ~ "LPS",
                               T~description),
         treatment = if_else(str_detect(participant_description, "Sham"), paste0(treatment, "_", "Control"), treatment),
         tissue = str_remove(tissue, "mouse "), 
         sex = "male",
         geo = "GSE7404") %>% 
  extract(
    col = participant_description, 
    into = c("timepoint", "participant_id"), 
    regex = "(\\d+\\s?(?:day|Day|hr))\\s+(rep\\s?\\d+)", 
    remove = T 
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_replace(timepoint, "hr", "Hour") %>% str_replace("day", "Day"),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, parse_number(timepoint))) %>% 
  select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint, sex, 
         strain = genetic, tissue, organism, treatment, platform_id) 


GSE_metadata_annotated %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, treatment)%>%
  summarise(n_sample = n()) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoint,
      size = n_sample,
      y = treatment,
      color = treatment) +
  geom_point()
  

#Save metadata
write_csv(GSE_metadata_annotated, file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_metadata.csv")))

#Get counts matrix ------
GSE_exprs <- eset %>% exprs()

#Save as RDS
GSE_exprs %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_exprs.rds")))
```

```{r}
#Import datasets
mouse_exprs = readRDS(here("tables", "trauma_burn_mouse_exprs.rds")) %>% 
  as.matrix() %>%
  { log2(. + 1) } %>% 
  as.data.frame()
mouse_metadata = read_csv(file = here("tables", "trauma_burn_mouse_metadata.csv")) %>% 
  mutate(status = if_else(str_detect(treatment, "_Control"), "Control", "Treated"),
         treatment = str_remove(treatment, "_Control"))

#Inputs
filename = "trauma_burn_mouse"

#Annotate genes ------
#Mouse -----
#Annotate data and calculate log2fc
mouse_exprs_metadata  = mouse_exprs %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe_id") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = 2:145,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "value_raw") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_metadata, 
             by = "geo_sample") 

#Get value from day 0 and calculate Log2FC (non-paired)
mouse_exprs_log2fc_sample = mouse_exprs_metadata %>% 
  filter(status == "Control") %>% 
  select(probe_id, treatment, timepoint, subject_num = participant_id, value_raw_ref = value_raw) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, treatment, probe_id) %>% 
  summarise(value_raw_ref = mean(value_raw_ref)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_exprs_metadata %>% 
               filter(status != "Control"),
             by = join_by("probe_id", "treatment", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(log2fc = value_raw - value_raw_ref) %>% 
  distinct() 

#Check duplicates
mouse_exprs_log2fc_sample %>% 
  filter(participant_id == "rep 1",
         treatment == "Burn",
         probe_id == "1415670_at")
```

```{r}
########### Filter and annotate probes -----
## Set up biomart
ensembl_mart <- useMart("ensembl")
ensembl_mart <- useDataset("mmusculus_gene_ensembl", mart = ensembl_mart)

## Get the MGI symbol
gene_id <- rownames(mouse_exprs) %>% unique()

# listAttributes(ensembl_mart) %>% View()
#Annotate
annot <- getBM(
  attributes = c("affy_mouse430_2",
                 "ensembl_gene_id",
                 "entrezgene_id",
                 "mgi_symbol",
                 "description"),
  filters = "affy_mouse430_2", #Probes
  values = gene_id,
  mart = ensembl_mart)

#Get lookup table from FIT
#Install model package
# library(devtools)
# devtools::install_github('shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man')
library(FIT.mouse2man)
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = mouse_ortholog)

#Get annotations for each probe 
### Filter probes with highest median expression
mouse_log2summary = mouse_exprs %>% #20,845 probes
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe_id") %>% 
  rename(probe = probe_id) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarise(median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot %>% 
              rename(probe = affy_mouse430_2), 
            by = "probe") %>%  #24.009 rows
  #Filter ensembl id
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  
  #Filter entrez id
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%  #21.863 probes/entrez_ids
  ungroup() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = entrezgene_id) %>% 
  
  #Filter hgnc symbol
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez, by = c("mouse_entrez", "mgi_symbol")) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1)  %>% #14.396
  ungroup()

#Filter out genes with multiple mgi_symbols
hgnc_symbol_dupes = mouse_log2summary %>% 
  #filter out ensembl id with multiple mgi_symbols
  get_dupes(hgnc_symbol)

mouse_log2summary = mouse_log2summary %>% 
  select(probe, hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  filter(!hgnc_symbol %in% c(hgnc_symbol_dupes$hgnc_symbol %>% unique())) 

#Modify expression matrix

#Filtered probes
mouse_log2_filtered_probes = mouse_exprs %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe_id") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename(probe = probe_id) %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_log2summary, by = "probe") %>%   #214,396
  select(human_symbol = hgnc_symbol,
         probe,
         c(mouse_metadata %>% 
             pull(geo_sample)))
#Check
mouse_log2_filtered_probes %>% dim()
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol = mouse_log2_filtered_probes 
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% get_dupes(human_symbol)

#Save
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds")))

mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds")))

mouse_exprs_log2fc_sample = mouse_exprs_log2fc_sample %>% 
  rename(probe = probe_id) %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
               select(human_symbol, probe),
             by = join_by(probe))

mouse_exprs_log2fc_sample %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "trauma_burn_mouse_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))
```

##### Limma
Unpaired samples design
```{r}
library(sva)
#Import
#Import
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(file = here("tables", "trauma_burn_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
mouse_metadata = read_csv(file = here("tables", "trauma_burn_mouse_metadata.csv")) %>% 
  filter(str_detect(treatment, "Burn"))

#Create Expression Set
eset_mouse <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData = mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
    column_to_rownames("human_symbol") %>% 
    select(all_of(mouse_metadata$geo_sample)) %>%
    as.matrix(),
  phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame(mouse_metadata %>% 
                                   column_to_rownames("geo_sample") %>% 
                                   mutate(condition = paste0(treatment, "_", timepoint))))

# Keeping only genes with intensity > 6 (log2) in at least 5 samples
genes_to_keep <- exprs(eset_mouse) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ . > 6)) %>% 
  rowSums() %>% 
  { . >= 5 }

eset_filtered <- eset_mouse[genes_to_keep, ]
```


```{r}
# 2. Preparação para SVA
dat <- exprs(eset_filtered)
metadata <- pData(eset_filtered)

# Matriz do que queremos preservar (Condição e Timepoint biológico)
mod  <- model.matrix(~ 0 + condition, data = metadata)
# Matriz nula
mod0 <- model.matrix(~ 1, data = metadata)

# 3. Estimar e rodar SVA
n.sv <- num.sv(dat, mod, method = "be") # 'be' é geralmente mais robusto para transcriptômica

if (n.sv > 0) {
  svobj <- sva(dat, mod, mod0, n.sv = n.sv)
  
  # 4. Criar o novo Design Matrix combinando Biologia + Surrogate Variables
  design_sva <- cbind(mod, svobj$sv)
  colnames(design_sva) <- c(make.names(colnames(mod)), paste0("SV", 1:n.sv))
} else {
  design_sva <- mod
  colnames(design_sva) <- make.names(colnames(mod))
}

# 1. Extrair as SVs
svs <- svobj$sv
colnames(svs) <- paste0("SV", 1:ncol(svs))

# 2. Unir com os metadados
df_check <- cbind(pData(eset_filtered), svs)

# 3. Testar correlação com o timepoint (ANOVA para cada SV)
lapply(1:svobj$n.sv, function(i) {
  fit_check <- lm(as.formula(paste0("SV", i, " ~ timepoint")), data = df_check)
  summary(fit_check)$adj.r.squared # Queremos valores BAIXOS aqui
})
```


```{r}
# Fatores biológicos reais
batch_factors <- c("condition", "timepoint")
pct_threshold <- 0.6

# --- PASSO A: PVCA nos dados ORIGINAIS ---
pvca_original <- pvcaBatchAssess(eset_filtered, batch_factors, pct_threshold)

# --- PASSO B: Remover o efeito das SVs para teste ---
# Criamos uma matriz de expressão "limpa" apenas para o PVCA
v_clean <- eset_filtered
exprs(v_clean) <- removeBatchEffect(exprs(eset_filtered), covariates = svobj$sv)

pvca_clean <- pvcaBatchAssess(v_clean, batch_factors, pct_threshold)

# --- PASSO C: Comparação Visual ---
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
barplot(pvca_original$dat, las=2, main="Original", col="gray")
barplot(pvca_clean$dat, las=2, main="After SVA", col="steelblue")
```




```{r}
# --- 2. Sample Weighting Diagnostic ---
# Using the SVA-adjusted design to calculate array weights
aw <- arrayWeights(eset_filtered, design_sva)

barplot(aw, 
        names.arg = eset_filtered$condition, 
        main = "Sample Weights Diagnostic (with SVA)", 
        ylab = "Weight", 
        las = 2, 
        cex.names = 0.7, 
        col = "skyblue")

# --- 3. Linear Modeling (Limma) ---
fit <- lmFit(eset_filtered, design_sva, weights = aw)

# --- 4. Contrast Matrix & Empirical Bayes ---
# We compare Burn vs Control at each specific timepoint
cont_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  Burn_2h = conditionBurn_2.Hour - conditionBurn_Control_2.Hour,
  Burn_D1 = conditionBurn_1.Day  - conditionBurn_Control_1.Day,
  Burn_D3 = conditionBurn_3.Day  - conditionBurn_Control_3.Day,
  Burn_D7 = conditionBurn_7.Day  - conditionBurn_Control_7.Day,
  levels = design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont_matrix)

# Using trend=TRUE and robust=TRUE to handle mean-variance trends and outliers
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2, trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)

# Diagnostic: Check the residual variance trend
plotSA(fit2, main = "Sigma vs Abundance (SVA + Weights Applied)")

# --- 5. DEG Extraction & Result Formatting ---
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
})

# Combine all results into a clean, tidy dataframe
all_degs_mouse_burn <- bind_rows(results_list) %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l,
         condition = comparison) %>%
  mutate(organism = "Mouse")

# Summary of Significant DEGs (Adj P-Value <= 0.05)
all_degs_mouse_burn %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_degs = n())
	
#Save
# all_degs_mouse_burn %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "burn_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

```

```{r}
# 1. Calcular o PCA
```

##### T test
```{r}
#Import
mouse_exprs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "trauma_burn_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
mouse_metadata = read_csv(file = here("tables", "trauma_burn_mouse_metadata.csv"))
log2fc_sample = readRDS(here("tables", "trauma_burn_mouse_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))

log2fc_sample_symbol = log2fc_sample %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_exprs %>% 
               select(human_symbol, probe_id = probe),
             by = "probe_id") %>% 
  select(-probe_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(treatment == "Burn")

log2fc_unpaired_ttest = log2fc_sample_symbol %>%
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    res = list(t.test(value_raw, value_raw_ref, paired = F, alternative = "two.sided", var.equal = F)),
    pval = res[[1]]$p.value,
    diff = res[[1]]$estimate[1] - res[[1]]$estimate[2],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(padj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired"
         )

log2fc_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "burn_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

```{r}
aw <- arrayWeights(eset_filtered, design)
barplot(aw, 
        names.arg = eset_filtered$condition, 
        main = "Sample Weights Diagnostic", 
        ylab = "Weight", 
        las = 2,          
        cex.names = 0.7,   
        col = "skyblue")

#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_filtered, 
             design, weights = aw) 

#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

#Get contrasts 
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

cont_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  # --- Burn Comparisons ---
  Burn_Early = conditionBurn_Early_Hours - conditionControl_Early_Hours,
  Burn_D1 = conditionBurn_Day_1  - conditionControl_Early_Hours,
  Burn_D3 = conditionBurn_Day_3  - conditionControl_Early_Hours,
  Burn_D7 = conditionBurn_Day_7  - conditionControl_Early_Hours,
  levels = design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont_matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2, trend = T, robust = T)

plotSA(fit2, main = "Sigma vs Abundance (Weights Applied)")

#Get DEGs
## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs and clean dataset
all_degs_human = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human") %>% 
  select(condition = comparison, everything()) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = symbol,
         mean_l2fc = log_fc,
         ci_upper = ci_r,
         ci_lower = ci_l)

all_degs_human$condition %>% unique()
	
# #Save
all_degs_human %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "burn_human_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

all_degs_human %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_degs = n())

```



##### T test
```{r}
#Import
human_exprs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "burn_human_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
human_metadata = read_csv(file = here("tables", "burn_human_metadata.csv"))
burn_human_log2fc_sample = readRDS(here("tables", "burn_human_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))

log2fc_sample_symbol = burn_human_log2fc_sample %>% 
  inner_join(human_exprs %>% 
               select(human_symbol, probe_id = probe),
             by = "probe_id") %>% 
  select(-probe_id) %>% 
  distinct() 

log2fc_unpaired_ttest = log2fc_sample_symbol %>%
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoints_new) %>%
  summarise(
    res = list(t.test(value_raw, value_raw_ref, paired = F, alternative = "two.sided", var.equal = F)),
    pval = res[[1]]$p.value,
    diff = res[[1]]$estimate[1] -  res[[1]]$estimate[2],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(padj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired"
         )

log2fc_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "burn_human_log2fc_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

### Fluad
```{r}
all_degs_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) 

mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
### Loop for every time point -----
all_degs_fit2 = all_degs_mouse %>% 
  select(symbol, EffectSize = mean, condition) %>%
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
               select(symbol = human_symbol, MM.Entrez = mouse_entrez),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(row = MM.Entrez)

# Generate csv for every condition
all_conditions <- unique(all_degs_fit2$condition)
purrr::walk(all_conditions, function(cond) {
  
  delete_dupes <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond) %>%
    get_dupes(row) %>%
    pull(row)
  
  filtered_df <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond, !row %in% delete_dupes) %>%
    select(-condition) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("row") %>% 
    select(MM.Entrez, EffectSize)
  
  file_name <- paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv")
  file_path <- here("tables", file_name)
  
  write_csv(filtered_df, file_path)
})

# FIT loop
fit_results_combined <- map2_dfr(all_conditions, all_conditions, function(cond, cond_name) {
  
  file_path <- here("tables", paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv"))
  
  fit_output <- FIT.mouse2man::FIT(MouseFile = file_path, DataType = "rnaseq")

  fit_output_tbl <- as_tibble(fit_output) %>%
    mutate(condition = cond_name)
  
  return(fit_output_tbl)
})
```

```{r}
#Merge results =====================
#Metadata
human_mouse_metadata_saureus = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) %>% 
  select(geo_sample, participant_id, organism, timepoint, time_unit, pathogen, treatment, age, sex, ethnicity, strain, tissue, tissue_infection, batch = batch_experimental) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Staphylococcus aureus",
         tissue = "Blood",
         timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint),
         age = as.character(age)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = if_else(timepoint == 1, 24, timepoint),
         time_unit = "Hour") 

human_mouse_metadata_ecoli = readRDS(here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) %>% 
  filter(host_strain == "C57BL/6J" | organism == "Human",
         !batch %in% c("1", "2")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint), 
         time_unit = "Hour", 
         pathogen = "Escherichia coli", 
         tissue = "Blood", tissue_infection = site_infection, 
         age = str_remove(age, "0.50-0.66"),
         organism = if_else(organism == "Mus musculus", "Mouse", organism)) %>% 
  select(geo_sample, participant_id = subject_id, organism, timepoint, time_unit, pathogen, treatment = status, age, sex, ethnicity, strain = host_strain,
         tissue, tissue_infection, batch) %>% 
  arrange(organism, timepoint)

human_mouse_engerix_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Hepatitis B",
         vaccine = "Engerix B",
       treatment = "Engerix B", 
       type = "VLP",
       timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint),
       age = as.character(age)) %>% 
  select(geo_sample, participant_id, organism, timepoint, time_unit, pathogen, vaccine, type, treatment, age, sex, ethnicity = race, strain, tissue)

fluad_human_mouse_metadata = readRDS(here("tables", "fluad_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))  %>% 
  mutate(time_unit = "Day", timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint), age = as.character(age)) %>% 
  select(geo_sample, participant_id, organism, timepoint, time_unit, pathogen, vaccine, type, treatment, age, sex, ethnicity, strain, tissue)

mouse_metadata_burn_trauma = read_csv(file = here("tables", "trauma_burn_mouse_metadata.csv")) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(treatment, "LPS")) %>% 
  separate(timepoint, into = c("timepoint", "time_unit")) %>% 
  separate(treatment, into = c("pathogen", "treatment")) %>% 
  mutate(tissue = "Leukocytes",
         organism = "Mouse",
         treatment = if_else(is.na(treatment), pathogen, treatment),
         timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
  select(geo_sample, participant_id, organism, timepoint, time_unit, pathogen, treatment, sex, strain, tissue)
  

human_burn_metadata = read_csv(file = here("tables", "burn_human_metadata.csv")) %>% 
  rename(timepoint_original = timepoint,
         timepoint = timepoints_new) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Burn", 
         organism = "Human",
         subject_id = if_else(subject_id == "Control", paste0(subject_id, "_", geo_sample), subject_id),
         timepoint = str_replace(timepoint, "_", " "),
         time_unit = if_else(str_detect(timepoint, "Day"), "Day", "Hour"),
         timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "Day "),
         timepoint = if_else(treatment == "Control", "0", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(geo_sample, participant_id = subject_id, organism, timepoint_original, timepoint, time_unit, pathogen, treatment, age, sex, tissue)

    mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
           age = as.numeric(age)),
  fluad_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
    mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
           age = as.numeric(age)),
  mouse_metadata_burn_trauma %>% 
    mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)),
  human_burn_metadata,
  human_trauma_metadata
) %>% 
  # Annotate timepoints
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Burn", "Trauma") & timepoint %in% c("2", "2h", "Early Hours") ~ "Early hours",
                               time_unit == "Day" ~ paste0("Day ", timepoint),
                               time_unit == "Hour" & timepoint != "Early hours" ~ paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                               T~timepoint),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, "Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", 
                                           "Day 1", "Day 2", "Day 3", "Day 4", "Day 5", "Day 7", "Day 14", "Day 28"),
         timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)) %>% 
                                str_replace(., "Early hours-Early hours", "2h-Early"))

all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, treatment, organism, timepoint)

all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))
```

```{r}
all_degs_human_mouse = bind_rows(all_degs_human_mouse_saureus, 
                                 all_degs_human_mouse_ecoli, 
                                 all_degs_human_mouse_fluad, 
                                 all_degs_human_mouse_engerixb,

                                 ) %>%

  #Annotate timepoints

                               pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B") ~ paste0("Day ", timepoint),
                               pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus") ~ paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                               T ~timepoint),
        timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, "Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", 
                                           "Day 1", "Day 2", "Day 3", "Day 4", "Day 5", "Day 7", "Day 14", "Day 28"),
         timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"),

all_degs_human_mouse_matched = 
  bind_rows(
    #Maintain all
    all_degs_human_mouse,
    
  #Duplicate Human infection timepoints with mouse
  all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human",
         treatment == "Infection") %>% 
  inner_join(all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
               filter(organism == "Mouse",
                      treatment == "Infection") %>% 
               select(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "pathogen") %>% 
    mutate(timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint.y, "-", timepoint.x)) %>% 
    rename(timepoint = timepoint.y) %>% select(-timepoint.x) 
  ) %>% 
  distinct() 

all_degs_human_mouse_matched %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::count(timepoint, treatment, pathogen, organism) 

all_degs_human_mouse_matched %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs_matched.rds"))
```

```{r}
all_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

human_degs = all_degs %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(test = "Limma",
         paired = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Unpaired",
                            pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B") ~ "Paired", 
                            T ~ pathogen)) 

mouse_degs = all_degs %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Influenza", "Hepatitis B") ~ "Paired",
                            pathogen %in% c("Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Paired", 
                            T ~ pathogen)) 

#Merge datasets
degs_ttest_limma =
  bind_rows(
    all_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    human_degs,
    mouse_degs
    ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         pathogen = as.character(pathogen),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~ pathogen),
          pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"))

all_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, timepoint)

all_degs%>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, timepoint)
```

Summarize and plot
```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
#Summarize  
degs_ttest_limma_summary = degs_ttest_limma %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint, test) %>% 
  summarise( n_degs = sum(padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup()

degs_ttest_limma_summary

# Plot number of DEGs per test and significance level
degs_ttest_limma_summary_plot_gg_1row = degs_ttest_limma_summary %>%
  filter(pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "HepB")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = timepoint,
    y = n_degs,
    fill = test
  )) +
  facet_wrap(~pathogen~organism, 
                    scales = "free",
                    space = "free_x",
                    # strip = strip_nested(size = "variable"),
                    nrow = 1
             ) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge2(width = 0.8),
           width = 0.5) +
  # Manual colors per test
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "t-Test" = "gray25",
    "Limma" = "#4DBBD5FF"
  )) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), n.breaks = 5) +
  
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(
    title = "Total DEGs by test and timepoint",
    subtitle = "Comparison across tests (FDR ≤ 0.05)",
    x = "Time",
    y = "DEGs",
    fill = "Test",
    alpha = "Pairing"
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray75", linetype = 3),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "gray75"),
    ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1))

  # Manual colors per test
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "t-Test" = "gray25",

  )) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), n.breaks = 5) +
  
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "DEGs",
    fill = "Test",
    alpha = "Pairing"
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray75", linetype = 3),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "gray75"),
    ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1)) 

degs_ttest_limma_summary_plot_gg_3row = degs_ttest_limma_summary %>%
```

```{r}
    fit_engerixb_results,
    fit_saureus_results %>% mutate(timepoint = as.character(as.numeric(timepoint)/24)),
    fit_ecoli_results %>% mutate(timepoint = as.character(as.numeric(timepoint)/24))
    ) %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(measure == "fit_prediction" ~ "FIT",
                             measure == "mouse_effect_size" ~ "Mouse",
                             T ~ measure),
         timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, as.numeric(timepoint))) 

all_fit_results %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "all_fit_prediction_results.rds"))

#Standardize with DGE output
all_human_mouse_fit = 
  
  all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus",
                                             "Escherichia coli"), 
                             as.character(round((as.numeric(timepoint)/24), 2)), 
                             timepoint)) %>% 
  
  bind_rows(all_fit_results %>% 
              filter(organism == "FIT") %>% 
              select(organism, pathogen, treatment, timepoint, human_symbol, mean_l2fc = value, 
                     ci_lower = ci_low, ci_upper = ci_high)) %>% 
  
  filter(
  #Filter out different times in infection in mice and FIT
  !(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") &
      organism == "Mouse" &
    timepoint %in% c("0.08", "0.17", "0.25", "1")))
all_human_mouse_fit

all_human_mouse_fit %>% 
  filter(pathogen == "Escherichia coli",
         organism == "Mouse") %>% 
  pull(timepoint) %>% unique()

```


```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=18}
all_human_mouse_fit$timepoint %>% unique()

#Visualize distribution
all_fit_results_histogram = all_human_mouse_fit %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = mean_l2fc,
      fill = timepoint) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~pathogen+organism, axes = "x",
               nest_line = element_line(linetype = 1, color = "black", size = 0.5), 
               scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  # geom_histogram(color = "white") +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count),
                   color = timepoint,
                   fill = timepoint),
                  position = position_identity(), 
               alpha = 0,
               size = 1.5,
              show.legend = T) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values =  c("0.08" = "#D0D8FB", 
                                   "0.17" = "#A1B0F7",
                                   "0.5" = "#4361ee",
                                   "1" = "#90e0ef",
                                   "3" = "#0096c7",
                                   "7" = "#184e77")) +
  scale_color_manual(values =  c("0.08" = "#D0D8FB", 
                                   "0.17" = "#A1B0F7",
                                   "0.5" = "#4361ee",
                                   "1" = "#90e0ef",
                                   "3" = "#0096c7",
                                   "7" = "#184e77")) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "lines"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(alpha = 0.5, linetype = 2)
        ) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(x = "Log2FC",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Timepoint (Day)",
       color = "Timepoint")

all_fit_results_histogram

all_fit_results_histogram %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "all_human_mouse_fit_results_histogram.png"), 
         width = 16,
         height = 5)
```
